description: This file defines a PHP class `KpiAPI` that acts as a REST API endpoint for managing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes methods for CRUD operations—retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting KPIs—and handles request validation, data transformation, and interaction with the underlying KPI service and data access objects.

classes.name: KpiAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class that manages KPIs for the performance module, providing methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting KPI records. Extends Endpoint and implements CRUD operations with validation, request handling, and data transformation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single KPI by ID, checks if it exists, determines if it is editable, and returns the KPI data encapsulated in a EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the id parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all KPIs with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Returns a collection of KPIs along with total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for filtering parameters of the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new KPI record based on request data, validates input, and returns the created KPI data.

methods.name: setKpi
methods.description: Populates a KPI entity from request parameters, including title, ratings, job title id, and default status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a KPI, including title, job title ID, and ratings.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Internal method to define common validation rules for KPI data including title, job title ID, ratings, and default flag.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing KPI identified by ID with new data from request, after validation and existence check.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a KPI, including ID validity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes KPIs specified by an array of IDs, verifies existence, and returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation: array of IDs.
